text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year to ya! Lookin' forward to 
workin' with ya again this year!

As the new year began, Yukino Bijin came 
to greet me right away. But...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I want you to train me as hard as you can!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With the Classic year starting, it means 
I'm finally, truly...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm gonna take on the Triple Tiara, yes 
I am...!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there'll be even more sparkling, 
dazzling girls than there were at the 
Hanshin JF."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I won't be able to win unless I 
try super, duuuper hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So, let's get straight to training...!

Her enthusiasm and drive are wonderful, 
but Yukino Bijin is a hard worker even at 
the best of times. I'd rather she use New 
Year's to recharge.
choice_data_list:
You worked so hard all year, there's no 
need to rush!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so? Um, in that case... today 
is our day off...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What're we s'posed to do on a day 
off?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was fully focused on just treating today 
like training, so I hadn't thought about 
any of that at all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We made and ate osechi and ozoni with 
everyone at the dorm, and what other New 
Year's things are there...
choice_data_list: What did you do back home?
What did you do back home?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, hanging out with Mifuyu-chan, taking 
care of my little sister... and lounging 
around.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Just lazing around, I suppose~ The 
kotatsu is simply the best, yeah."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Still! I came all the way to the big 
city! I gotta pull myself away from the 
kotatsu!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Is there anything like that, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
Play with all your might and have a 
blast!!
Relax with a cup of coffee.
Copy how a model spends her day

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I've always liked moving my body, y'see. 
Since coming here, I've had seniors who 
know a lot about that teach me all sorts 
of things."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's an obstacle course nearby! Let's 
go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hey, pretty nice, right? Well then—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's Yuki-chan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! What a total coincidence! Happy 
New Year!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ticket-zo-san! Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! This is Ticket-zo-san, the one 
who told me about this place!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's Winning Tiiiiicket!! I love to run, 
and my dream is the Derby! I look forward 
to working with youuuuuu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did you come to work out too, 
Ticket-zo-san?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I was just lazing around, and then I 
started getting the itch to move!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, the Derby's this year, right? I just 
can't sit still!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So, I was gonna train, but I got scolded 
like, 'You were going at it until the last 
second yesterday too, so rest up~'

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! I totally get it...! To be honest, I 
was thinking about training today too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see! Yuki-chan is taking on the Triple 
Tiara this year too, right!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's both do our best to make our dreams 
come true! Ei, ei, oh!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! Since we're here, wanna 
hang out together?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I look forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Then let's climb that mountain next! 
Let's go, Yuki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! You too, Trainer~!

And so, I ended up tagging along with the 
two tough girls and their games...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—U-Um, Trainer... Are you okay? You're 
staggering around.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then should I just carry you? You're 
practically weightless, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm fine too! Let's carry it together!

Carried alternately by the two umamusume, 
it marked the beginning of a lively new 
year.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Taking your time is important, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, Cafe-san, my roommate, 
told me about this wonderful coffee shop! 
It felt like a great place to just relax."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think? Nice atmosphere, 
right?
choice_data_list: Ah... But why are you whispering?
Yeah... But why are you whispering?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I was wondering if I should act more 
grown-up in a shop like this."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Please, don't worry about it. It's just 
a casual cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hello, Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cafe-san! Haven't seen you since this 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...You've taken a liking to this 
café, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The parfait Cafe-san recommended was so 
delicious! I just had to share it with 
you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I see. ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Did you know there are delicious sweets 
other than parfaits?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's pudding. They're very particular 
about the ingredients, so there's only a 
limited amount made each day.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...There aren't many customers today, so 
maybe they still have some left?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pudding...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay! Please do!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're leaving already?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If it's alright with you, I thought we 
could go together, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Since you have the chance, why don't the 
two of you take your time and relax?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'd be even happier if Cafe-san could 
join us too!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little bit, then.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Please, have a seat right next to me!

And so, the three of us welcomed a 
relaxing New Year together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawaa! Nice one, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There was a magazine feature before about 
how City-san spends her days off... and I 
clipped it out!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll go look it up, so please hold on a 
sec!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—The city really is amazin'. To think 
there're shops open right after New 
Year's.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I heard City-san checks out cosmetics a 
lot. I wanna find somethin' cute here 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh? For real. Happy New Year~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: W-Wah...! H-Happy New Year, don-gansu!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Congrats. So, what are you doing... Wait, 
shopping?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Talk about high beauty standards! 
Meanwhile, we're off to get ramen right 
now. Our idea of killing time is just 
eating.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I'm not going. Besides, I 
don't care anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...That series over there. It's 
affordable and good quality, so check it 
out if you're interested."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You came to check out the cosmetics, 
right? Looking for... my recommendations, 
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Aren't you a sweetie~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey~. Isn't your attitude kinda totally 
different from when you're with me~? So 
blatant~. Such favoritism~. Unfaaair~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I already gave you a sample, didn't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Not that~! Be gentle with me too, and talk 
with waaay more love☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Annoying.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. Real gals sure are full of 
energy, even during New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's really educational.

And so, I spent a delightful New Year with 
Yukino Bijin.
